media.title: Codex-built SwiftUI and RealityKit game running in the iOS Simulator

title: Build and Verify a SwiftUI RealityKit Game with Codex
summary: Ray Fernando reports turning an image and iterative feedback into a playable Swift 6, SwiftUI, and RealityKit game in 5 hours 48 minutes, with Codex driving Blender-to-USDZ art and checking the result on screen. An iOS team can pair rapid visual iteration with explicit simulator playthroughs and a passing Swift test suite before treating a generated build as complete.
takeaway: Require a generated game to pass automated Swift tests and simulator playthroughs, then use on-screen review as the next feedback loop instead of accepting the first polished demo.
